name: legacy_gold_perks
pages: Extra Scarce resources from Mining, Herbalism and Skinning. Scarce mats are the ones worth holding.
Sometimes extra Merchant's Favor from the Azeroth Commerce Authority or Durotar Supply and Logistics.
A chance for extra cooking results, and a chance to catch extra fish.
A daily cooldown that speeds up skill-ups. With every tradeskill at 300 it gives free Elemental Essences.
Lower prices on items bought from vendors (Blizzard gives no exact amount).
Class spells stop needing bought reagents, and tier 1 camp features need no materials.
Less durability lost when you die, so smaller repair bills.
Each character picks its own perks, so a gatherer and a crafter can take different trees.
Every challenge you finish on any character adds to the pool for all of them.
